  • Build secure-by-design hardened software that must withstand real-world attacks, while processing untrusted data and communicating with a backend over the internet

  • Located in the following locations: Romania, India, Poland

About the Role

This is an ideal opportunity for a highly motivated individual to get in on the ground floor as we build out our Technical Support function at Cyberhaven. The Technical Support Engineer candidate is passionate about technology, is always curious, and driven to delight customers. A true problem solver, you will take personal ownership in seeing a problem through to resolution or escalating and collaborating with some of the most talented engineers in the world. You will become an expert on Cyberhaven’s Data Detection and Response platform, understand how it interacts with all the endpoints our customers interact with, and understand how our customers are trying to reduce data loss threats across the organization. 

Ideally, you will be comfortable speaking with security and customer operation teams. You must have technical depth, be client obsessed, and experience with a Saas based security product. Having the desire to take initiative, own and resolve customer issues, and love working in a fast paced, high growth environment is key. This role reports to the Director of Support.

What you’ll be doing

  • Provide well-thought out and reliable directions in technical and non-technical terms, to help customers solve reported issues and guide them on proper use of our platform.

  • Take ownership of customer issues, including initial troubleshooting, identification of root cause and issue resolution or escalation.

About the role

We’re looking for an experienced systems software engineer to help drive and evolve our product. This person would extend and own our on-endpoint network proxy solution, intercepting and manipulating the network traffic of third party software.   • Hook or redirect outbound connections, terminate and re-establish TLS sessions, and apply content-aware policies in real time

  • Add low-level collectors that trace data flows across apps, files, sockets, and pipes, feeding a unified event stream

  • Solve challenging performance optimization problems: we’re building software that monitors hundreds of thousands of events with minimal impact on performance of the endpoint applications

  • Design and build highly reliable code that never impacts the end-user experience

  • Build secure-by-design hardened software that must withstand real-world attacks, while processing untrusted data and communicating with a backend over the internet

  • 3+ years of professional experience in systems software, networking, proxy, or security engineering, with strong depth in network interception and low-level systems.

  • Strong track record in network interception and parsing

  • Prior work on at least one forward proxy used by security software

  • Experience debugging, profiling, and optimizing the performance of low-level system software

  • Proficient in designing and implementing application architecture

  • Experience with agile development and SCRUM

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help build, scale, and optimize the infrastructure and developer platforms that power our engineering teams.

  • Take ownership of infrastructure challenges, troubleshoot complex production and development environment issues, and implement long-term solutions.

  • Establish and promote infrastructure-as-code, GitOps, and cloud-native engineering best practices.

  • Partner closely with software engineers to understand developer pain points and deliver scalable self-service infrastructure and tooling.

  • Define and track key metrics around deployment efficiency, build times, infrastructure reliability, and developer experience.

  • Contribute to technical architecture discussions, mentor engineers, and help establish engineering standards and documentation.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Developer Experience.

  • Strong experience designing, deploying, and managing production-grade infrastructure on GCP (preferred) or another major cloud platform.

  • Deep hands-on expertise with Kubernetes (GKE), Terraform, and containerized environments.

  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, or similar technologies.

  • Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), GitOps, cloud-native architecture, and deployment automation.

  • Experience improving developer workflows, reducing deployment friction, and optimizing build and release processes.

  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes clusters, and CI/CD systems.

  • Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python, Go, or Bash to develop automation and internal tooling.

  • Experience with monitoring, observability, cloud security, and infrastructure performance optimization.

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to independently drive infrastructure initiatives from design through implementation.

  • A collaborative, proactive engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges and enabling other engineering teams to move faster.

Cyberhaven is looking for a Chief of Staff for Engineering to collaborate and perform as an operating partner and force multiplier for engineering leadership, driving operating cadence, cross-organizational execution, and data-driven decision making across the entire engineering org. This role is accountable for turning strategic priorities into clear execution plans, and for giving leadership the visibility, metrics, and follow-through they need to run engineering like a well-oiled machine.

This is a hybrid role that blends program management, project management, and executive operations: the person in this role will sit close to engineering leadership, represent their priorities across the org, and be the connective tissue between strategy and day-to-day execution. Influence and impact come from judgment, trust, and cross-functional credibility rather than direct authority.

This role also serves as the primary architect of engineering leadership's monthly and quarterly business reviews, all-hands content, org planning, and leadership offsites providing decision support, surfacing risk, and driving follow-through on the company's highest-priority engineering initiatives.

This role goes well beyond traditional chief of staff work. It requires strong executive presence to represent leadership credibly in front of the org and external stakeholders, deep comfort with data and metrics to turn fragmented signals into clear decision support, and an AI-forward mindset to automate the reporting and operating mechanisms that let Cyberhaven scale how it plans, tracks, communicates, and reviews its work.

What you'll do

Strategic Partnership and Executive Support

  • Act as a trusted advisor and thought partner to engineering leadership, helping translate strategic priorities into clear execution plans, success criteria, and operating mechanisms across the org

  • Own the engineering leadership operating cadence, including staff meetings, monthly and quarterly business reviews, org planning, and leadership offsites, setting agendas, preparing materials, and driving follow-through on decisions and action items

  • Represent engineering leadership's priorities across the organization, ensuring alignment between engineering, product, and go-to-market teams on key initiatives

  • Prepare executive-facing communications, board and all-hands content, and cross-functional updates on behalf of engineering leadership

  • Act as a sounding board and extension of leadership on sensitive or ambiguous organizational topics, including headcount planning, org design, and prioritization tradeoffs

  • Build trust and credibility across engineering, product, and business stakeholders to effectively drive alignment without formal authority

Program and Project Management

  • Own end-to-end planning, execution, and coordination across complex, multi-team programs and time-sensitive strategic projects for engineering leadership

  • Improve predictability in Cyberhaven's release and planning model by tracking scope changes, readiness risks, and cross-team dependencies

  • Build and maintain review cadences, status updates, and action follow-up systems that surface execution risk and areas needing intervention across teams and programs

  • Support high-priority or ambiguous engineering initiatives that need additional structure, executive visibility, and follow-through, often stepping in where no clear owner exists

  • Improve data hygiene and governance in systems like Jira and related planning artifacts so that ownership, status, and progress signals are reliable

Data and Metrics-Driven Operations

  • Define and standardize success metrics across quality, release health, velocity, and team health to drive greater predictability and accountability

  • Turn operational signals from across the org into clear, data-backed reporting and decision support for engineering leadership

  • Own the metrics and narrative behind monthly and quarterly business reviews, ensuring leadership has accurate, timely, and actionable data

  • Bring a data-driven lens to org health, from delivery metrics to team sentiment, to help leadership spot risk early

AI-Forward Automation

  • Build AI-assisted dashboards and reporting workflows that improve visibility into program health, release scope, delivery risk, and team performance

  • Create automations that connect tools like Jira, Notion, GitHub, and Slack to surface planning, execution, release, and other delivery signals

  • Automate recurring chief of staff and program management processes such as status collection, follow-up tracking, review preparation, and stakeholder reporting

  • Use these workflows to improve business review inputs, leadership updates, and recurring status reporting while reducing manual status chasing

Who you are

  • 7+ years of experience in a role combining program management, project management, and executive or leadership support

  • Prior experience as a Chief of Staff or Engineering Leadership roles a plus

  • Strong executive presence and the judgment to represent leadership credibly across the org and with external stakeholders

  • A data-driven, metrics-driven approach to decision making, with the ability to turn fragmented operational signals into clear reporting and insight

  • Proven ability to drive accountability, coordination, and follow-through across engineering and product teams without direct authority

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience owning monthly and quarterly business reviews, executive-facing updates, and cross-functional status reporting

  • Comfort using automation and AI to improve reporting quality, operating efficiency, and recurring workflow execution

  • Good judgment in prioritization, escalation, and leadership support in ambiguous or fast-moving situations

  • Experience owning QBRs, executive reporting, all-hands content, or org planning processes

  • Familiarity with DORA-style metrics, SLO/SLA thinking, release hygiene, and delivery scorecards

  • Experience building AI-assisted dashboards, automations, or reporting systems

  • Experience working in security, SaaS, endpoint, platform, or infrastructure-heavy environments

  • Experience supporting globally distributed engineering organizations

  • Prior experience transitioning from a technical or program management background into a Chief of Staff or executive operations role

  • Located in the Eastern Timezone to support our Global team.

In this role, you will be responsible for enabling customers to achieve intended business outcomes from Arelion products and services by driving service performance, operational alignment, and continuous improvement across the customer lifecycle.

 

Requirements 

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in telecommunications, service management, customer success, or customer operations. 
  • Solid technical understanding of telecom services and supporting technologies, including IP, WDM, fiber, and related service assurance concepts. 
  • Strong analytical, reporting, documentation, and presentation skills. 
  • Experience using analytics and reporting tools such as Qlik or similar platforms. 
  • Strong customer focus and business mindset. 
  • Ability to work effectively with both operational and executive stakeholders in a global, multicultural environment. 
  • University degree or equivalent relevant experience. 
  • Fluent written and spoken English is required. 

Nice-to-haves 

  • ITIL certification. 
  • Knowledge of service management frameworks. 
  • Knowledge of additional major customer languages. 

 

Main Accountabilities 

  • Customer success and service value realization across assigned strategic customer relationships. 
  • Customer-facing service performance, service review outcomes, and improvement follow-up. 
  • Operational alignment between customer expectations, product capabilities, support processes, and service assurance delivery. 
  • Customer feedback, portal adoption, and service experience insights translated into improvements. 
  • Customer-facing problem management and recurring issue resolution in collaboration with operational teams. 
  • Reliable documentation, reporting, and governance input for customer-facing service management activities. 

Core Responsibilities 

  • Build trusted customer relationships and act as the customer voice within Customer Operations. 
  • Lead structured service reviews, including preparation, presentation, feedback capture, and follow-up of agreed actions. 
  • Own and coordinate follow-up on customer issues, complaints, outage credits, RFOs, and incident-related reports within the service management scope. 
  • Collaborate with Sales during pre-sales and customer engagement phases to align operational commitments and expectations. 
  • Represent customer requirements in customer portals, SLA measurement, reporting, and supporting system development initiatives. 
  • Plan, conduct, and analyze customer feedback activities, including NPS and other service experience inputs. 
  • Trigger and drive customer-facing problem management for recurring or high-impact issues, ensuring improvement actions are progressed. 
  • Maintain and improve customer-facing service documentation such as customer handbooks, support guidance, and service communication materials. 
  • Use data, insights, and service performance reporting to identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve ways of working. 

What we offer   

  • Continuous learning and career growth opportunities 
  • Professional training and English/Spanish language classes   
  • Comprehensive medical insurance 
  • Mental health support 
  • Specialized benefits program with compensation for fitness activities, hobbies, pet care, and more 
  • Flexible working hours 
  • Inclusive and supportive culture 

About Us 

Established in 2011, Trinetix is a dynamic tech service provider supporting enterprise clients around the world. 

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, we have a global team of over 1,000 professionals and delivery centers across Europe, the United States, and Argentina. We partner with leading global brands, delivering innovative digital solutions across Fintech, Professional Services, Logistics, Healthcare, and Agriculture. 

Our operations are driven by a strong business vision, a people-first culture, and a commitment to responsible growth. We actively give back to the community through various CSR activities and adhere to international principles for sustainable development and business ethics. 

To learn more about how we collect, process, and store your personal data, please review our Privacy Notice: https://www.trinetix.com/corporate-policies/privacy-notice

Якщо ти шукаєш простір можливостей для постійного масштабування і любиш задачі із зірочкою — тоді тобі до нас. Шукаємо Full Stack Developer в нашу команду Mental Health.

Що на тебе чекає:

  • Місія посади: Долучитися до нашої невеликої команди розробки, повністю розібратися в архітектурі та взаємозв'язках усіх сервісів, брати активну участь у розробці та підтримці продукту (веб, мобайл, бекенд), а також впливати на технічні рішення.

  • Виклики: Наша найближча ціль — міграція всіх сервісів на нову інфраструктуру. В перспективі — запуск нових продуктів.

  • AI-driven підхід: Ми максимально інтегруємо AI у робочий процес (Claude, Codex, OpenRouter). AI навіть бере участь у code review! Це дозволяє нам бути продуктивнішими та фокусуватися на архітектурних рішеннях.

Про тебе:

  • Маєш 2+ роки комерційного досвіду розробки.

  • Впевнено володієш React, React Native, Node.js, буде плюсом - MongoDB.

  • Маєш досвід роботи з code review.

  • Важливо: Ти відкритий до використання AI-інструментів у роботі та готовий активно їх впроваджувати.

  • Ти відповідальний, стабільний та проактивний спеціаліст.

  • Буде плюсом: Досвід роботи в продуктових компаніях та досвід з мобільними додатками.

Про твої задачі:

  • Розробка та підтримка веб-версії продукту та мобільного додатка на React Native.

  • Робота з бекенд-сервісами (мікросервісна архітектура на Node.js + Fastify).

  • Робота з CMS та Funnel Builder.

  • Участь у двошаровому процесі code review (людина + AI).

  • Активна взаємодія з AI-інструментами для підвищення власної продуктивності.

  • Пряма комунікація із замовниками та вплив на технічні рішення.

Твій шлях до позиції:
[CV Screening > HR Interview > Tech* & Final Interview > Job Offer]

*Можливий Live Coding

Щоб зосередитись на головному та реалізовувати свій потенціал – важливо мати зручні умови. Тому ми подбали про все: від можливостей для зростання до речей, які просто роблять щоденну роботу комфортнішою.

Щоб зростати:
Ми підтримуємо твої амбіції і прагнення до нового:

Щоб працювати комфортно:

  • Гібридний формат роботи (ремоут або офіс);

  • Тимбілдинги та внутрішні клуби за інтересами.

[HR Interview > Tech Interview> Final Interview > Reference Check > Job Offer]

  • Впевнено працюєш з Linux, розумієш мережеві принципи та модель OSI, вмієш діагностувати та вирішувати мережеві проблеми;

  • Знайомий з Nginx, PHP-FPM, RabbitMQ, Redis та ELK-стеком;

  • Буде плюсом інтерес до сучасних інструментів AI/LLM та їх застосування для автоматизації DevOps-процесів;
